name: Adam
description: Man living at the time before the Flood

points: God brought every beast of the field and every fowl of the air unto Adam to see what he would call them, and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof. Was Adam equal to, over, or underneath these creations? Over them. He was given power over them; the man was at the top. But for Adam there was not found an help meet for him: still nothing that was just for him.

note.label: Respect: The Evidence Of Her Faith

points: Adam named all the cattle and the fowl and every beast of the field, and among all of them there was no help meet found for him. He was created alone with nobody to help him.
Adam's job was to serve God and Eve's job was to serve Adam. That is what a help meet is.

note.label: The 5 Signs of a Good Wife

points: Adam had dominion and the power to name every living creature, which is what ruling the earth looked like.
There was not found an help meet for him: the animals had mates and Adam had none, because he was the first man ever made and there were no other people around.

note.label: Escape Thankskilling : Oh God & My Lord

points: Go all the way back to the beginning, to why marriage was made. It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. The Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, took one of his ribs, and made he a woman. This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

note.label: Agree Together | Bound Not Bondage

points: The Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, took one of his ribs, and made he a woman. This is the Most High doing this for his son: a gift. The gift still remains today for every man; that is why we call her your rib. There is a woman that was made just for you, because it is not good that man should be alone.

note.label: Respect: The Evidence Of Her Faith

points: She was taken out of Adam, so she is part of Adam. Adam called her woman because she was taken out of man; woman means she came from us.

note.label: The 5 Signs of a Good Wife

points: Eve was in Adam before she was ever taken out of him, and woman means out of man: that is the pattern the whole class is built on.

note.label: Escape Thankskilling : Oh God & My Lord

points: The Most High created Eve from Adam because there was no woman on the earth right for him at that time.

note.label: Genesis 2: Adam, the Chosen of the Most High

points: The trees of the garden here are people. Adam and his wife tried to hide their sins among the other people that were in the garden with them.

note.label: Genesis 3: The Craftiness of Your Enemy

points: Satan did not go to Adam. He went to Eve, the weaker vessel, and she brought it to her husband.
When God called, Adam blamed the woman God gave him, and she blamed the serpent.

note.label: Transforming from Immorality into Beautiful Civility Part 2

points: The Most High was not looking for Adam as though He could not find him; He was calling Adam to examine himself.
Adam had started to separate himself from the Most High by covering and hiding his sins, and the Most High already knew what he had done.

note.label: Genesis 3: The Craftiness of Your Enemy

points: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife: because you listened to what she had to say, cursed is the ground for thy sake. And Adam called his wife's name Eve, because she was the mother of all living.

note.label: Respect: The Evidence Of Her Faith

points: Because Adam hearkened to his wife and broke the commandment, the ground was cursed for his sake; in sorrow and sweat he would eat of it all his days.

note.label: Genesis 3: The Craftiness of Your Enemy

points: Eve was the mother of all living before the fall, and Adam had children in the heavens.
Adam was made lord of all creatures, and of him came the people God chose.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

points: The first sacrifice is twofold. A literal lamb was slain here to clothe Adam and his wife, and that lamb slain from the foundation of the world represents Christ, slain for our sins.

note.label: Genesis 3: The Craftiness of Your Enemy

points: Cain did not build a metropolis for one wife and one child. There were many people around at this time, because Adam and Eve had many children, inside and outside of the Garden of Eden.

note.label: Nolan Wells: The Perpetual Hatred We Never Learned

points: Adam knew his wife; she conceived and bare Cain. These are the children they had when they were cast out of the garden; Cain, their firstborn that they had when they were cast out. I'm emphasizing that. And Eve said, I have gotten a man from the Lord.

And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city. Obviously it was a bunch of people around at this time; Adam and Eve had children prior; that's where Cain got his wife from. Cain built the city, and that city was called Enoch.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: Seth was appointed another seed instead of Abel. Through Seth men began to call upon the name of the Lord; they started to worship the Most High and keep the commandments, while the line of Cain went on in evil and wickedness. That is why the Most High chose the line of Seth.

note.label: Genesis 4: Cain, Abel, and the Sons of the Wicked

points: The sons of God begin to be sent down and born through Adam and Eve.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

points: The words made he him speak of the first Adam. This Adam was made in the likeness of God, a direct descendant of the Most High.
Chapter 5 is the direct lineage of Adam. That lineage is the sons of God you read of in chapter 6, and the later chapters of Genesis tie the Israelites directly to the lineage of Adam through Shem.

note.label: Genesis 5: The Book of the Generations of Adam

points: Male and female created he them, and called their name Adam: they were not that Adam; these were the other people on the earth. When the Most High creates a fish He does not create only a salmon; there is mackerel and tuna and all types of fish. In the same way, He created Adam and He created the other people.

note.label: Genesis 5: The Book of the Generations of Adam

points: This is the book of the generations of Adam: Adam begat a son in his own likeness, after his image. Adam was called the son of God, so his son was made in his image, meaning a son of God as well.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

points: Notice Seth was in Adam's likeness, after Adam's image. It did not say that about Cain; it said Cain was of that wicked one. Cain was in the image of Satan, not in the image of Adam.
Everybody came from Adam, but everybody is not a child of God. Satan's kids come from Adam too; that was Cain's lineage.

note.label: Religion - The False Prophet

points: You notice it keeps saying they begat sons and daughters, but it names specific names, because these particular children were significant: they birthed prophets. The other sons and daughters, there was wickedness. That's why Noah was found perfect: he had siblings, but he was mentioned because he was the righteous one out of all the sons of God at the time dealing with the daughters of men.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel. You thought God wants everybody to just come together and hold hands? The God of this Bible has been a God of division from day one; he separated the sons of Adam according to where he had to place the children of Israel, meaning this world revolves around Israel.

note.label: Deuteronomy 32: The Song of Moses, Prophecy of Israel's Fall and the Most High's Vengeance

points: But they like men have transgressed the covenant, there have they dealt treacherously against me. We broke the covenant, and that is the lawsuit the Lord brought against us as a nation.

note.label: Blood Toucheth Blood

points: Adam was called the son of God, and in his lineage through Seth were also the sons of God, not Cain.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

points: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come. Adam was a similitude of Christ, but not as the offence: Adam brought the offence and Christ brought the opposite, the free gift. If through the offence of one many be dead, paradise removed and the flood, much more the grace of God by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many. They parallel: one brought death upon the chosen nation and one brought life upon it.

note.label: Navigating Through Paul's Letters: Walk Through of Romans 5

points: As in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive. Prior to this truth we were not spiritually alive; we were dead, following the course of this world.

note.label: Pay The Price: Pleasure Now Regret Later

points: For Adam was first formed, then Eve: Paul took it all the way back to the beginning and said the reason for silence is because there's order with God. And Adam was not deceived: Satan didn't go to Adam to get them kicked out of the garden. But the woman being deceived was in the transgression: why did she get deceived? Cuz she didn't believe that God was enough for her.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: For Adam was first formed, then Eve. Paul went all the way back to the beginning to deal with this situation of the woman being disorderly; that is why it is relevant. And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression: he is telling you what happens when you allow the women to lead and get out of their roles.

note.label: Respect: The Evidence Of Her Faith

points: Adam was formed first and was not deceived; the woman being deceived was the one in the transgression.

note.label: The 5 Signs of a Good Wife
